title: Compute Instance IBB - standardized output contract

status.description: Shared status vocabulary across every IBB (05-standards-contracts.md §10). 'partially completed' exists deliberately: an interface that cannot distinguish it from failure produces orphaned resources nobody owns.

result.description: Present when status is completed or partially completed. resourceId and operationalState are the baseline every capability returns; instanceId/privateIp/publicIp/availabilityZone are compute-instance's capability-specific fields agreed per scaffold-ibb SKILL.md §1b.

instanceId.description: The provider's identifier for the created/modified instance (e.g. an AWS instance id).

publicIp.description: The instance's public IP address; null when networkExposure is private.

availabilityZone.description: The actual resolved zone identifier (e.g. "us-east-1a") the availabilityZoneIndex mapped to.
